title.to: Example use cases (consumers of the BotSpy library)

description.from: Optional consumers that demonstrate BotSpy: examples/ directory or an optional botspy[metrics] extra. Never in core required dependencies. Must stay blocked-by the Query, export, and CLI epic.
description.to: Optional examples that consume the botspy Rust library directly as Rust code (examples/ in the crate or integration tests): the thanks-vs-F-bombs meter, local sentiment analysis (VADER default, optional GoEmotions transformer), and a placeholder for similar metrics. No binary, no CLI, no extra crate; blocked-by the Layer 3: Query and export epic.
